newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Aerospace plans $300 mln plane - leasing firm.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Aerospace plans $300 mln plane - leasing firm.

text.p: Taiwan Aerospace Corp said on Friday it plans to set up a US$300 million joint-venture aircraft-leasing company with several domestic and foreign partners.
"Our chairman Jack Sun said details for partners in the US$300 million venture will be finalised in two months at the soonest," a company spokeswoman said by telephone.

Domestic partners were expected to account for 70 percent of the venture, with the remaining 30 percent taken by foreign partners in Asia-Pacific. The latter category was likely to include mainland Chinese investors, she said.
Taiwan Aerospace will account for the biggest stake among domestic partners, she said.
The venture plans to purchase 70 passenger aircrafts to conduct leasing business for short-distance flight, and expects an annual sales revenue of US$2 billion, she said.
Taiwan Aerospace, capitalised at T$5.24 billion, is 35 percent owned by the Taiwan government. It was founded in 1991 as the main vehicle to develop the island's fledgling aerospace industry.
